task.title: P6-086 residue: silent no-op click on unparseable pending, widget-replaces-typed-facet, e2e window fencing
task.description:
Residue from P6-086 review (2026-08-12) — mid-debounce edge semantics plus polish:

1. Silent no-op facet click on unparseable pending text (rail.rs ~:451): with a half-typed term in the box (bolt c:, open quote), a facet click or Reset inside the 250ms window is silently dropped — rewrite refuses, no navigation, checkbox never moves. Better than the original clobber, but a dead click. Consider surfacing (brief shake/toast) or queueing the edit for after the debounce settles.
2. Widget-replaces-typed-facet (rail.rs ~:450): the rewrite value comes from URL-derived widget state but applies to the PENDING text — hand-type c:u then click Red mid-window and the typed c:u is replaced by c:r (same shape for s:/t:/r:/o:/mv; Field::Name owns_every_match so it drops every bare word). Narrow (hand-typed grammar + mid-window click) but text the user typed is eaten. Consider merging per-field rather than replacing.
3. e2e window pre-assertions (filter-rail.spec.ts ~:102,:140) assert inside-the-window BEFORE .click() — vacuous-pass if the click actualizes late, flake-red if the fill-to-assert gap exceeds 250ms. Consider clock control.
4. RailTextField (rail.rs ~:763) sets self_pushed before commit, which can now refuse — the field then claims an edit that never reached the URL.
5. query_bar.rs ~:98 unused #[derive(Clone)] on ArmedCommit; ~:187 the private-slot fallback is live only for bench/unit renders and untested.
6. rail.rs ~:1765 unit test covers base_query+rewrite only, not the QueryBase read/consumed ordering seam.
